techniques.name: 多行单色文字块滚动及重复接续
techniques.intent: 用一个多行文字块快速形成同色弹幕，再复制接续延长覆盖。

timing.equation: u=t-start; x(u)=W-(W+text_width+padding)*u/T for one chosen linear traverse; repeat/next block uses explicit phase and start

pitfalls: One text block shares a common color/style in the demonstrated UI; independent message colors require separate layers or a richer text renderer.
Copying blocks does not automatically prevent gaps or duplicate overlap; check actual bounding boxes over time.
Exact proprietary marquee wrap/easing behavior is unknown; linear traverse is an explicit code choice.
Historical text length limits are UI-specific, not intrinsic to the compiler.
validation: Inspect text entry, midpoint and exit to confirm direction and intended pace.
Check repeated blocks for visual gaps and unreadable overlap.
Verify line spacing and readable placement without covering the important subject.

techniques.name: 分层弹幕行、错时出现和独立颜色
techniques.intent: 让每条弹幕具备自己的内容、行位置、速度、开始时间和颜色。

jitter_s.implementation_note: Seeded jitter is a reproducibility choice, not a tutorial-demonstrated algorithm.

timing.equation: speed_i=(W+width_i+padding)/traverse_i; x_i depends on local t-start_i
timing.rule: Longer text moves farther in the same traverse time; changing text requires measuring width again.

pitfalls: Equal durations do not imply equal pixel speeds for unequal text widths.
Random-looking start shifts can produce collisions; the screenshots do not prove collision-free scheduling.
Seven groups and21tracks are examples, not required architecture or upper limits.
Exact flower-text/bubble presets need assets; plain per-message color is mathematically direct.
After changing content, reuse lane/layout structure but recompute widths and collision checks.
validation: Measure text widths with the actual font and verify intended traverse timing.
Inspect same-lane bounding boxes through overlapping time intervals.
Check colors for contrast against actual moving backgrounds.
Re-run layout/collision checks after text, font or canvas changes; fixed seed reproduces chosen jitter.

techniques.name: 可选乐器库音与淡入淡出
techniques.intent: 在允许的声音方案中为静音画面增加独立、标明来源的配乐。

timing.rule: Audio ends with intended picture interval; fades operate on final trimmed audio duration.

pitfalls: Added guitar-library sound is not evidence of the guitarist's original performance or synchronization.
Do not add library music to original-only or mute-all requests.
Source silence and audio quality require actual inspection/audition, not ASR alone.
validation: Confirm provenance and permitted use of library sound.
Audition gain/fades and ending; avoid falsely presenting accompaniment as original synchronous sound.

unknowns: No audio audition or continuous playback performed.
ASR is unverified; source silence and optional guitar sound identity are not certified.
Exact proprietary marquee easing, wrap positions, flower-text styles and current UI limits are unknown.
